fields._ipv6_accept_defrtr: dropped: stock radio pair copied into ipv6_accept_defrtr at Apply; the Reaper toggle posts ipv6_accept_defrtr itself
fields._ipv6_radvd: dropped: stock radio pair copied into ipv6_radvd at Apply; the Reaper toggle posts ipv6_radvd itself
fields.ipv6_dhcp_end_end: dropped: the hex suffix input; Reaper builds ipv6_dhcp_end = prefix::suffix exactly as stock did
fields.ipv6_dhcp_start_start: dropped: the hex suffix input; Reaper builds ipv6_dhcp_start = prefix::suffix exactly as stock did
fields.ipv6_ifdev_select: dropped: stock select copied into ipv6_ifdev at Apply (flets forces eth, hidden means ppp); Reaper posts ipv6_ifdev with the same rule
fields.ipv6_only: dropped: the IPv6 Only row shows only with the v6only flag and no Reaper model reports it (rc/init.c never adds it), so stock never posted it here; rc still reads the stored value (ntp.c, udhcpc.c) and Reaper leaves it untouched
fields.ipv6_prefix_span_for_end: dropped: read-only display of the pool prefix (shown as text on the Reaper page)
fields.ipv6_prefix_span_for_start: dropped: read-only display of the pool prefix (shown as text on the Reaper page)
fields.ipv6_unit: dropped: posted only by the stock second-WAN switch (action_mode change_ipv6_unit); see wan_selection
fields.wan_selection: dropped: the second-WAN selector. Stock shows it only with dual WAN on and the mtwancfg flag, and rc reads the ipv61_* settings only on RTCONFIG_MULTIWAN_CFG / MULTIWAN_IF builds (shared/misc.c ipv6_nvname_by_unit); no Reaper model builds either, so it never appears and the second WAN's IPv6 settings are never used
